name: @anywalletkit/networks
description: Networks for Any Wallet Kit wallets: the catalog of mainnets with public RPC failover lists, default testnets for every chain family, user-added networks and custom RPCs (NetworksTable over any JSON storage), per-family endpoint verification (chain id / genesis / global id must match) and the http-only-for-local-nodes URL policy. Shared by the mobile app and the extension kit.
